question: At which complete residual-state boundary does the dominant upstream oracle effect become a stable, non-reconstructed causal state?

prior_art.known_lessons: A complete module write is not the carried residual state; absolute downstream clamps must not be implemented as deltas; a final-state patch is a positive-control interface rather than localization evidence.
prior_art.novelty: Cross each fixed upstream oracle with the absolute complete residual state at thirteen ordered boundaries while leaving x0 and recurrent attention state native, exposing reconstruction versus persistent carriage.

frozen_design.evaluation: Opposite-parity fixed oracle projectors; v15 A1/A2/P/C only; no refit, gain, or outcome-selected boundary.
frozen_design.intervention: Replace the complete residual tensor through each row's semantic position at exactly one boundary; x0 and recurrent attention state v1 remain native to the execution.
frozen_design.accounting: Rowwise margin rescue, reset loss, bypass, and Mobius interaction; cellwise P/C KL and flips. Report every boundary in fixed serial order.
frozen_design.lockin_rule: The earliest boundary through post_mlp16 for which reset and rescue both clear .75 projection/.875 direction in every expert/parity own-target cell and every later boundary through post_mlp17 also clears those bars.

predictions.pred_a_authority_replay_closure_finitene: All hashes, native/self replays, row coverage, factorial closures, finiteness, exact 120-forward count, and literal price pass.
predictions.pred_b_entry12_residual_state_carries_up: Entry12 reset and rescue each project >=.75 with direction fraction >=.875 in every expert/parity own target.
predictions.pred_c_final_residual_state_closes_logit: Post-MLP17 reset and rescue each project >=.95 with direction fraction >=.875 in every expert/parity own target.
predictions.pred_d_stable_preterminal_lockin_boundar: The frozen lock-in rule selects a boundary no later than post-MLP16.
predictions.pred_e_lockin_boundary_is_control_select: At the selected boundary, reset and rescue add zero P/C flips and changed-versus-background mean KL <=.02 in every expert/parity cell.

decision: A or C failure invalidates the instrument. B failure identifies carriage in an unpatched auxiliary state or unexpected downstream reconstruction. D selects the earliest stable state interface for reader localization; D failure identifies diffuse/recurrently reconstructed state. E gates selective promotion but does not erase localization.
closed_claims: semantic identity of a residual coordinate
